name: GA1.5c setup: the savings ledger is loaded and empty
GA1.5c the ledger row for a real reply carries loke's measured optimisation, and no token or cost saving
js: (async()=>{const of=window.fetch;let cap=null;window.fetch=async function(u,o){const r=await of.apply(this,arguments);if(String(u).indexOf('/api/pipeline')>=0){try{cap=await r.clone().json();}catch(e){}}return r;};const i=document.getElementById('chat-input');i.value='summarise the weather data for the week please';submitMessage();let h=[];for(let k=0;k<80;k++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));h=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('moke_savings_history')||'[]');if(h.length&&cap)break;}window.fetch=of;if(!cap)return 'no /api/pipeline reply captured';const o=cap.optimisation;if(!o||typeof o.bytes_before!=='number')return 'loke reply carries no optimisation: '+JSON.stringify(cap).slice(0,200);sessionStorage.setItem('ga15c_opt',JSON.stringify(o));const e=h[h.length-1];const t=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('moke_savings')||'{}');const same=!!e&&e.measured===true&&e.method===o.method&&e.bytesBefore===o.bytes_before&&e.bytesAfter===o.bytes_after&&e.charsBefore===o.chars_before&&e.charsAfter===o.chars_after;const clean=!!e&&!('tokensSaved' in e)&&!('costSaved' in e)&&!('tokensSaved' in t)&&!('costSaved' in t);const tot=t.bytesBefore===o.bytes_before&&t.bytesAfter===o.bytes_after&&t.measuredRequests===1;return (same&&clean&&tot)||JSON.stringify({row:e,totals:t,loke:o}).slice(0,400);})()

name: GA1.5c session stats show the saving as not measured
GA1.5c the privacy review before a cloud request says its cost is not measured, and shows no price
js: (async()=>{const oldMode=localStorage.getItem('moke_approval_mode');const oldStats=sessionStorage.getItem('moke_session_stats');localStorage.setItem('moke_approval_mode','always');const st=JSON.parse(oldStats||'{}');st.cloudCount=1;sessionStorage.setItem('moke_session_stats',JSON.stringify(st));const i=document.getElementById('chat-input');i.value='summarise the weather data for the week please';const p=submitMessage();let t='';for(let k=0;k<40;k++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));if(document.getElementById('confirm-modal').style.display!=='none'){t=document.getElementById('confirm-stats-row').textContent;break;}}confirmCancel();try{await p;}catch(e){}if(oldMode===null)localStorage.removeItem('moke_approval_mode');else localStorage.setItem('moke_approval_mode',oldMode);if(oldStats===null)sessionStorage.removeItem('moke_session_stats');else sessionStorage.setItem('moke_session_stats',oldStats);return (/Costnot measured before sending/.test(t)&&!/\$/.test(t))||('modal: '+t);})()
